description:
Building code violations and building permits on record with the city for one address, free, from the city's
        own records (the same sources the title search report reads). `city`: chicago, philadelphia, cincinnati, mesa,
        glendale-az (Glendale, Arizona), gilbert, buffalo or provo (list_coverage returns the current list). `address`:
        street address starting with the house number, e.g. "233 S Wacker Dr"; the city is added when missing.

        Returns counts over every record on file (total, open, severe, in court, balances due, active / expired permits)
        and the five most relevant violations and permits. Some cities publish only one of the two (Glendale: violations;
        Gilbert, Provo: permits). status: 'ok'; 'not_found' (no parcel matches: ask the user to check the address);
        'not_searched' (outside city limits: the message says why); 'unavailable' (the city's service did not answer:
        not a 'no violations' answer; retry later).
name: building_records_lookup
